filing.title: Nova Retail Group 10-Q quarterly report
filing.bodyText:
FORM 10-Q
Nova Retail Group (Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter)
For the quarterly period ended March 31, 2026
Trading Symbol(s) NOVA New York Stock Exchange
Results of Operations
Revenue decreased 18% to $84.0 million from $102.4 million in the prior-year quarter. The decline was driven by lower store traffic and reduced average order value in the home category. Net income was $2.1 million for the quarter. Cash and cash equivalents were $76.0 million at March 31, 2026.
